name: APPS
description: Automated Programming Progress Standard is a benchmark of 10,000 Python programming problems from competitive programming platforms (Codeforces, Kattis, LeetCode), spanning introductory, interview, and competition difficulty levels. Tests code generation with test case verification.
evaluation_method: pass rate against hidden test cases
typical_sota_score: ~60-70% pass@1 on introductory; much lower on competition level
reputation: Influential competitive programming benchmark; introduced by Hendrycks et al.; covers a range of difficulties from introductory to competition level
notes: Problems sourced from real competitive programming platforms. Three difficulty tiers: introductory (~2300), interview (~5000), and competition (~2700). Competition-level problems remain very challenging for LLMs.
